179)༄༅/blo gsal 'jam dpal bzang po la brda sprod kun bshad kyi brtags ming gsol ba'i smon tshig drang srong bden pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/'jam dpal ga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ blo gsal 'jam dpal bzang po la brda sprod kun bshad kyi brtags ming gsol ba'i smon tshig drang srong bden pa'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer gyis// mtsho byung lha mo bzhad pa'i dge sar bkra// zab rgyas chos tshul myong ba'i sbra ma ras// brtson pa'i skyes tshal mchog tu khyod gyur cig /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'chi med lhas rtsen lam// rnam dpyod nyi zlas gting mtha' tshol ba la// kun nas kun tu bskor bas mdzes pa yis// srid pa gsal ba'i mig tu khyod gyur cig /klu thogs la sogs shing rta che'i// man ngag bdud rtsi'i zil mngar des// myos pa'i raḥyig gnyis pa yi// khyu mchog nyid du khyod gyur cig /dngos po stobs zhugs dus mtha'i byin za'i gzis// phas rgol log smra'i tshang tshing gzhil ba la// 'jigs med dpa' bo chos kyi grags pa yis// rnam thar ma lus yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gyi// brda sprod gnas la thogs med pa'i// 'jig rten mig gcig bai ro yi// mthu byin snying la 'bar gyur cig /bdud rtsi snying (180)po yan lag brgyad pa yi/ gso ba rig pas gzhan phan sgrub pa la// gu ṇa nā tha la sogs rgyal sras dang*// rgyal ba'i rnam thar bdag gir byed gyur cig /bsod nams bye ba'i tshong zong che// thar lam snang ba'i gter gcig pu// bco brgyad bzo yi rigs rnams la// snang byed bdag po nyid gyur cig /gnang bkag mtshams kyis srung ba'i rgyal ba dgyes pa'i tshul khrims lte ba la// shin sbyangs bde ba 'dren pa'i de bzhin gshegs dga'i ting 'dzin mu khyud mdzes par dkrigs// so so yang dag rig bzhi'i spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol ba'i shes rab rtsibs stong ldan// bslab gsum gser gyi 'khor los drangs pa'i 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyis 'byor gyur cig // ces bkra shis rtags kyi grangs ldan tshigs su bcad pas smon pa'ang sgra dbyangs padma'i myu gus so/// /
